address: 3519 Van Buren Boulevard, Riverside, CA 92503, USA

observations: Hero section features a large close-up photograph of a smiling woman's mouth with white text overlay reading 'Magnolia Modern Dental Creating Contagious Smiles in a Peaceful Atmosphere'
Black navigation bar at top with white text links and a white-bordered 'Call Us' button in the upper right corner
Elegant serif typography used for the main headline with a decorative curved divider element below the hero text
Beige/cream colored section below the hero with 'TOUR OUR SANCTUARY' heading in large serif type, followed by body text and a 'Gallery' button
Mobile version maintains the same layout and proportions as desktop with readable text and accessible tap targets; hamburger menu replaces horizontal navigation but hero remains fully legible

rationales.visualCraft: Matches the anchor 3 almost exactly with the same hero image, typography, and layout structure—competent execution with professional photography but clearly from a template or common design pattern
rationales.clarityHierarchy: Strong visual hierarchy with clear practice name, value proposition, and prominent 'BOOK NOW' CTA in the hero; phone number easily accessible in header on both desktop and mobile
rationales.modernity: Contemporary flat design with large hero image and generous whitespace, but the serif typography and beige palette feel safe and conventional rather than distinctively current
